items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases. Evidence: security covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are not evidenced. Compliance is technical-only with 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown. No credential exposure, exploit, or vulnerability is established. Exact decision: do not clear go-live or security-sensitive releases; preserve existing private-launch gates. Permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Reject new scaffold admissions and other new security-sensitive work this cycle; retain only existing canonical work after normal release review and capacity/site-overlap clearance. Continue the authorized read-only evidence matrix without requesting duplicate telemetry or mutating production.

Security handoff: retain the consolidated read-only control-evidence matrix. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns, affected scope, owner, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets, container isolation, release/deploy integrity, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, or clear gates based on missing evidence.
